profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Motivated mechanical engineering professional with experience in consulting for petrochemical companies. I exhibit strong leadership qualities and expertise necessary to meet project demands. I offer much resourcefulness in performing significant data analysis in compliance with engineering codes and industry standards.  

Expertise:
 - Stress analysis, computations, and modification of design. 
 - Research, design, and machining.
 - Characterization of materials.
 - Nondestructive evaluation.

positions.insights: Skills: Machine Design · Corrosion Engineering · Fluid Mechanics · Power Generation · Nuclear Engineering · Fluid Dynamics · Mechanical Engineering

positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
- Manage multiple projects for large companies in the oil-refining/petro-chemical industry.
- Responsible for attention to detail, generating results in compliance with industry standards and engineering codes.
- Perform data analysis respective to design using engineering software such as PV Elite, Ceasar II 2013, and Microsoft excel.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Thesis: "Micro-Fabrication of Point-of-Care Devices Using Cost-Effective Micro-Milling and Polymer Laminate Technique"

NSF, Next Generation Composites CREST Center; Baton Rouge, LA

Investigated/developed a low cost microfabrication process that eliminates dependency on     expensive high precision machines in creating polymer microfluidic devices for clinical services.

- Designed low-flow velocity multifunctional device with low aspect ratio for clinical diagnostics.  
- Characterized micro-machine tool for micro-fabrication of device with polymer film materials.  
- Developed design using 3D modeling software Autodesk Inventor. 
- Machined device using CNC micro-milling tool and CAM software ArtCAM. 
- Troubleshoot micro-fabrication process, determining minimum chip thickness of the cut tool for best results.  

Accomplishments:
Presented, "Sustainability Conference", April 22-26, 2013
Presented and Organized, "2012 Science and Engineering Regional Conference", April 4-6, 2012

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Participated in aerospace studies in the examination of polymer resins and carbon fiber composites    best suited for pressure vessel design in cryogenic environment. 
 - Examined strength and elasticity of carbon fiber composites, heat treated metals, polymer resins, and  friction stir welded aluminum samples. 
 - Experienced with ASTM standards for testing and setup.  
 - Compile and interpret data. Select best material properties for design to meet service requirements in its working environment.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Participated in nondestructive evaluation of composites research.
- Fabricated composite graphite/epoxy laminates. 
- Coordinated with graduate students in creating LabView program for signal detection.

Accomplishment: 
Presented, "Research Association of Minority Professors Conference",
February 4-5, 2010
